Palworld Archipelago Mod
WARNING: This build is in Alpha and can be broken. Please test it solo first before using it in a sync or async multiworld.

### Untested Elements

• Multiplayer functionality
• Multiplayer worlds (only minimal testing has been performed)
• Compatibility with other mods

### How to Play

1. Subscribe to this mod and to UE4SS Experimental (Palworld).
2. Enable both mods under Options > Mod Management and restart the game.
3. Load a new Palworld world.
4. Open the in-game chat and type: !!connect host:port slotname [password]
5. Play. Your items will show up directly in the chat.
6. To leave, type !!disconnect or return to the title screen.

### Goal

Defeat the first tower boss or complete the quest: The Rayne Syndicate.

### Gameplay Changes & Randomization

## Technologies

• Technology unlocks are locked in the menu. You cannot unlock a technology until you have received its corresponding item from the multiworld.
• Several items are progressive. Each copy you receive unlocks the next tier (e.g., Progressive Bow, Progressive Armor, Progressive Weapon).

## Progression Logic Disclaimer

• Area keys and progressive levels are part of the multiworld logic to decide which locations the generator expects you to reach.
• In this alpha version, the mod does not enforce these restrictions in-game. It will not stop you from walking into any area or from leveling up early. This might be changed in a later update.

## Tracked Locations (Items Sent)

• Pals: The first time you catch each of 36 specific pals (e.g., Pal: Chikipi, Pal: Lamball).
• Quests: Completing each of the 14 main quests leading up to the first tower (e.g., Set Up a Workbench, Catching a Pal).
• Levels: Reaching level 2 up to level 10 (Reach Level 2, etc.).
